content: The Executor successfully handled the complex HWPX (XML-based zip) manipulation task. Key success factors included: 1) Dynamic namespace handling for Hancom-specific XML tags (hp, ooffice, etc.), 2) Robust placeholder replacement across all section*.xml files, 3) Precise regex-based transformations for numeric values ('참석자수') and score formatting ('만족도'), and 4) Correct removal of stale layout cache elements (<hp:lineSegArray>) which is critical for HWPX viewers to re-render the modified text. The use of lxml.etree to preserve the document structure while modifying text nodes ensured a valid output.
reasoning: The task involved specific domain knowledge (HWPX/XML structure) and complex string/XML manipulation. Reflecting on why it succeeded (namespace handling and layout cache removal) provides valuable signal for future document-processing tasks.
